programs.title: Big Brother
programs.desc: When a girl becomes a victim of acid attack, her mild-mannered brother Dev is enraged. He takes the law in his own hands to teach a lesson not only to her attacker but also to those who victimised other girls in the past in a similar manner.

programs.title: Dedh Ishqiya
programs.desc: Khalujan and Babban seek refuge at the Majidabad palace as they run from the law. Khalujan tries to woo a wealthy widow with poetry, Babban and the widow's assistant plan a kidnapping.

programs.title: Dus
programs.desc: Jambval, a terrorist, plans to wreak havoc in Canada during Indian PM's visit there. Now, Siddharth, the head of the Indian Anti-Terrorist Squad, must lead his team to uproot Jambval's plans and apprehend dreaded terrorist.
